selected_evidence.summary: Validated projects share targets the staged projects directory, permits only designer, is writable, runs on node1, and remains active after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Guest tree connection returned ACCESS_DENIED; the private sibling share and traversal attempts failed with no leaked files, including after both reboots.
drawing.txt and materials.csv retain their original SHA-256 hashes; the protected contracts file is also unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use legacy-compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5; Samba 3.0.33 packages for CentOS 5 were installed.

Healthy baseline boot ID 1a67… was captured, reboot acknowledged and disconnect observed, then changed boot ID f410… plus recovered Samba processes, listeners, firewall rules, accounts, data hashes, authenticated reads, and guest denial were proven.

Healthy baseline boot ID e303… was captured, reboot acknowledged and disconnect observed, then changed boot ID 78db… plus persisted client package, credentials, SMB reads, and post-restart updates were proven.
